data.long_meaning: The name Mord is of uncertain origin, but it is believed to mean 'mighty' or 'short'. In some sources, it is suggested that the name may derive from the Old English word 'mord', meaning 'death' or 'murder'. However, this is not widely accepted, and the true origin of the name remains a mystery. The name Mord carries the meaning “Mighty or Short” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mord usually hope their child will grow to embody mighty or short and live with faith, good character and purpose.
